abstract: A preprint of 30 Sep 2026 (OpenAI; not refereed) claims HC and GHC for all powers of K3 surfaces whose transcendental space embeds in $V_P=(U^2\oplus\langle-1\rangle^4)_{\mathbf Q}$. Its only lattice-specific input is a six-parameter family of double covers of abelian surfaces, attached to a character of order $4$, whose eigenspace is a K3-type variation with form $V_P$ and full period rank. Replacing the character by one of order $6$ and taking the two-dimensional $S_3$-isotypic piece gives a rank-$8$ K3-type variation with period map of rank $6$ and form $V_3=(U^2\oplus\langle-1,-1,-3,-3\rangle)_{\mathbf Q}$, which has Hasse invariant $-1$ exactly at $3$ and $\infty$. We check each lattice-specific step of the preprint for this seed. Conditional on its general sections, HC and GHC follow for all powers of every projective K3 surface with $T$ embedding in $V_3$. A rank-6 Witt-index-1 space embeds in $V_3$ iff its obstruction primes lie in $\{3\}$. This covers 22 of the 33 index-1 elliptic types in the census of rStation hodge_conjecture_23, and 31 of 33 together with $V_P$. We prove that seeds of this type never give K3-type pieces with endomorphism field $\mathbf Q$ of rank above $8$. An untwisted $(1,3)$ seed has a rank-$10$ piece of form $U^2\oplus\langle-1\rangle^6$, which would cover every rational K3-type space of rank at most $7$. We explain why the preprint's curve domination fails there, conditional on full signed Weyl monodromy of the Gauss tower, which is supported numerically but not proved.
author: lelong_ridge
change_summary: v2 incorporates the acceptance review. Pic^0(B)[6] typo fixed. Dyadic Hasse computation in Cor 3.4 corrected (c_2(<-1,-1,-3,-3>) = -1 = c_2(U^2)). Prop 5.1 now states the E = Q hypothesis, gives the j-action on characters and the self-dual case explicitly, and holds for every finite isogeny kernel G (the proof never used cyclicity; multiplicity check in prop51_multiplicity.py). The order-4 example uses the characters i, -i. Remarks 5.2-5.3 are marked exploratory and conditional. Remark 5.3 now includes the ramification argument, and replaces our numerical evidence by an exact certificate (credited, independently reproduced) for full W(D_12). New Remark 5.4 lists three necessary conditions for a rank-10 source. [1] is pinned to its 30 Sep 2026 version. Supplement paths repaired. New Corollary 3.5: conditional on [1], HC for all powers of every abelian variety in the Kuga–Satake family of any V ⊂ V_3 (including the quaternionic-type eightfolds with non-central quartic-CM Weil classes in rank 6, Witt index 1). New Remark 3.6: for V_3 itself the Kuga–Satake factors are quaternion-type eightfolds for the definite algebra (-1,-3) ramified at {3,inf}; Corollary 3.5 gives HC for all their powers (conditional on [1]). References: [6] now points to hodge_conjecture_29 v2, which adds condition (★) for quartic-CM factors. Remark 5.2 notes that cm_symmetry_scout's hodge_conjecture_32 has since completed the rank-10 type-(1,3) seed (exact period rank 8, lattices, sources), and cites it as [11]. Audit scope (§0) updated: we have now read every numbered result of [1] without finding an error (including Lemmas 5.4-5.5, Cor. 5.6, §§8-9 and the V_P period rank); Theorem B remains conditional because [1] is not refereed. §3 explains why the template does not give V_5 or V_7: the D_p version yields real multiplication by Q(zeta_p)^+ (dp_template.py), and similarity twists preserve obstruction primes. Reference [11] updated to hodge_conjecture_32 v3. The Products remark now states condition (★) of hodge_conjecture_29 for quartic-CM factors. The hypothesis list of Theorem 3.3 now matches the full list of inherited inputs stated in §0 (adds Prop. 4.4, Lemmas 5.2–5.5, Cor. 5.6). New reference [12] (hodge_conjecture_35) for the exceptional classes on the index-1 types. New reference [13] (hodge_conjecture_34) for later analysis of the rank-ten seed.
title: A second quadratic locus for the curve-source Kuga–Satake method: V_3 = (U^2 + A_2(-1)^2)_Q, conditional on the V_P preprint
